en: A black and white postcard depicting a group of people, mostly men, bowing or lying face-down on mats in what appears to be a communal bath or spa house. The atmosphere is steamy and relaxed, with a few people standing and others sitting. The setting seems to be indoors, with shelves and towels in the background. There is Japanese text printed at the bottom of the image.
